# Exceptions {#top}

This section lists the exceptions that the entries of this reference throw, by type. Under each type are the
entries that throw it.

One exception is thrown by so many entries that it is described here once. dreamor numbers the rows of a set and
the entities of an `EntityVector` with 32-bit integers when it indexes them. An index holds up to 2^32 - 2 rows or
entities. Building an index over 2^32 or more rows or entities throws `std::length_error`. dreamor builds such an
index wherever it finds a row, a group or an entity by its key.

## `HighsCallError` {#highscallerror}

- `dreamor::highs::HighsEnv` if HiGHS rejects the collected model at the first call to `highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::HighsEnv::HighsEnv` if HiGHS rejects `options`.
- `dreamor::highs::HighsEnv::highs` if HiGHS rejects the collected model.
- `dreamor::highs::HighsEnv::addVariable` if HiGHS rejects the variable or its name after the first call to `highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::VarTable::VarTable` if HiGHS rejects the columns or their names after the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::VarTable::solution` if HiGHS rejects the collected model at the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::addConstr` if HiGHS rejects the row or its name after the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::setObjective` if HiGHS rejects the objective after the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::setObjective` if HiGHS rejects the objective or the sense after the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::minimize` if HiGHS rejects the collected model or the objective.
- `dreamor::highs::maximize` if HiGHS rejects the collected model or the objective.
- `dreamor::highs::val` if HiGHS rejects the collected model at the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::val` if HiGHS rejects the collected model at the first call to `env.highs()`.
- `dreamor::highs::val` if HiGHS rejects the collected model at the first call to `env.highs()`.

## `std::length_error` {#stdlength_error}

- `dreamor::IndexSet::groupBy` if the set has more than 2^32 - 2 rows.
- `dreamor::Grouped::Grouped` if `set` has more than 2^32 - 2 rows.
- `dreamor::highs::HighsEnv::highs` if the collected model has more columns or rows than `HighsInt` can count.
- `dreamor::highs::addConstr` if the rows collected before the first call to `env.highs()` hold more terms in total than `HighsInt` can count.

## `std::logic_error` {#stdlogic_error}

- `dreamor::highs::VarTable::solution` if the `Highs` holds no feasible primal solution.
- `dreamor::highs::val` if the `Highs` holds no feasible primal solution.
- `dreamor::highs::val` if the `Highs` holds no feasible primal solution.
- `dreamor::highs::val` if the `Highs` holds no feasible primal solution.
- `dreamor::mathopt::VarTable::solution` if `result` has no primal feasible solution.

## `std::out_of_range` {#stdout_of_range}

- `dreamor::EntityVector::at` if no entity has the key.
- `dreamor::EntityVector::at` if no entity has the key.
- `dreamor::Grouped::at` if `group` is greater than or equal to `size()`.
- `dreamor::Ordered::at` if `position` is `size()` or greater.
- `dreamor::internal::backend::VarTableCore::operator()` if the table's set has no row with the key.
- `dreamor::internal::backend::UnbuiltSum::build` if the term is a `VarTable` and the key of a row is not in the table's set.
- `dreamor::ParamTable::operator()` if the table's set has no row with the key.
- `dreamor::SolutionTable::operator()` if the table's set has no row with the key.
- `dreamor::mathopt::VarTable::solution` if `result` comes from solving another model.

## `std::runtime_error` {#stdruntime_error}

- `dreamor::indexedName` if the name is longer than 255 characters.
- `dreamor::FormatBuffer` if `Policy` is `kThrow` and the name that `format` writes is longer than `N - 1` characters.
- `dreamor::NameBuilder::NameBuilder` if `Policy` is `kThrow` and `root` is longer than `kMaxLength` characters.
- `dreamor::NameBuilder::restart` if `Policy` is `kThrow` and `root` is longer than `kMaxLength` characters. The builder is then left as it was.
- `dreamor::NameBuilder::append` if `Policy` is `kThrow` and the name would be longer than `kMaxLength` characters.
